rows.control_objective: Password authentication is not exposed to untrusted networks.
rows.risk_addressed: Exposed password logins let attackers guess or reuse credentials at internet scale.
rows.test_procedure: Count authentication attempts by method and source; identify password attempts from external addresses.
rows.evidence: 344631 failed password attempts from 1008 distinct external IPs
rows.recommendation: Disable password login (PasswordAuthentication no), require key-based auth or MFA, and restrict port 22 to a VPN or allow-list.

rows.control_objective: Successful remote logins use strong authentication (keys or MFA), not passwords alone.
rows.risk_addressed: A guessed password gives an attacker full access when no second factor or key is required.
rows.test_procedure: Take every successful login in the period and test the authentication method used.
rows.evidence: 182 of 182 successful logins used a password.
rows.recommendation: Require public-key authentication or MFA for all remote logins.

rows.control_objective: Direct privileged (root/admin) SSH access is disabled.
rows.risk_addressed: Compromise of a root or admin login gives complete control of the server.
rows.test_procedure: Count attempts and successes against privileged accounts.
rows.evidence: 332784 attempts against privileged accounts; 0 successful root logins
rows.recommendation: Set PermitRootLogin no; use named accounts with sudo and session logging.

rows.control_objective: Logins occur within expected working hours.
rows.risk_addressed: Out-of-hours access can indicate misuse or a compromised credential.
rows.test_procedure: Test the timestamp of each successful login against 07:00-19:59 server time.
rows.recommendation: Confirm the logins with the account owner; alert on out-of-hours privileged access.

rows.control_objective: Individual accounts are not used from many different source addresses.
rows.risk_addressed: One account used from many networks suggests shared or stolen credentials.
rows.test_procedure: For each account with a successful login, count distinct source IPs.
rows.evidence: 5 of 9 accounts logged in from 3 or more source IPs.
rows.recommendation: Review the accounts; remove sharing; bind access to known networks or a VPN.

rows.control_objective: Lockout or rate limiting stops guessing after about 5 attempts.
rows.risk_addressed: Without lockout, attackers can try unlimited passwords.
rows.test_procedure: Measure attempts per attack episode against the lockout threshold.
rows.evidence: 1221 of 1265 attack episodes exceeded 5 attempts; 157 exceeded 50; worst episode 86294 attempts
rows.recommendation: Deploy fail2ban or equivalent (ban after 5 failures / 10 min), lower MaxAuthTries, add network-level rate limiting.

rows.control_objective: No successful login follows a run of failures from the same source.
rows.risk_addressed: A success after many failures is the signature of a guessed password.
rows.test_procedure: Join each successful login to failed attempts from the same IP in the previous 60 minutes.
rows.evidence: 1 successful login(s) preceded by >= 3 failures within 60 min
rows.recommendation: Reset credentials and review session activity for the affected account(s); force MFA.

rows.control_objective: Monitoring rules cover the bulk of malicious authentication activity.
rows.risk_addressed: Activity outside detection coverage goes unnoticed by the SOC.
rows.test_procedure: Compare failed attempts inside detected incidents with all failed attempts.
rows.evidence: Detection rules cover 99.2% of failed attempts
rows.recommendation: Tune thresholds in config.py and forward alerts to the SIEM / ticketing queue.
rows.framework_reference: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.15, A.8.16; NIST CSF 2.0 DE.CM

rows.control_objective: sshd MaxAuthTries is consistent with the PAM retry limit.
rows.risk_addressed: Mismatched settings mean the intended lockout policy is not enforced.
rows.test_procedure: Search logs for PAM messages that it is ignoring its max-retries limit.
rows.evidence: 37963 log entries show PAM ignoring its max-retries limit (sessions reached 6 tries against a limit of 3)
rows.recommendation: Align sshd MaxAuthTries with the PAM limit so that lockout policy is actually enforced.

caption: 9 controls tested against the log. Each result states the population tested and how many exceptions were found. References are to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0.
